method.name: Regularized independent additive partial-order preference simulation
method.missingPolicy: Missing components and public priors use neutral 50 (centered contribution 0), not raw zero. Expose coverage; never redistribute coefficients.
method.undefinedScorePolicy: null if every positively activated term is missing; the deliberately all-zero model returns intercept 50 for everyone
method.coefficientConstraints: 0 <= beta[k] <= 10 independently; no sum constraint; fixed intercept 50; gamma=0 during expert fitting
method.coefficientInterpretation: A 10-point increase in component k adds beta[k] score points, holding other components fixed.
method.observationPolicy: All pairwise comparisons within the published list plus explicit constraints; no implicit loss for unlisted players
method.interpretation: Preference simulation only; no Bayesian posterior or probability claim
method.fitValidation: Nine deterministic starts; in-sample comparisons reported, no held-out validation
method.dataFreshnessNote: Source publication dates describe opinions, not updates to the fixed player-data snapshot.
